findings.F1: Inside the choppy calm profile, the excess 7-day return is not graded with the scaled weekly rise: by quintile of the scaled 7-day rise it is +1.3 %, −1.4 %, −2.1 %, −4.0 % and then +7.5 % (day-clustered t 0.44, −0.49, −1.31, −1.71, 1.97; 25 to 35 cases on 17 to 24 days each), so the whole effect sits in the top fifth.
findings.F2: Even that top fifth is unstable by year: on cases with a positive scaled rise in profile, 2018 had −8.3 % (t −2.83, 13 cases) and 2019 had −2.8 % (t −1.77, 22 cases). Only 2020 (+3.0 %, t 1.04) and 2021 (+7.7 %, t 2.36, 25 cases) were positive, and the top quintile's gain in 2021 (+12.7 %, t 2.30) rests on 6 days.
findings.F3: Splitting by agitation instead of the full profile, the weekly rise continues in calm markets across all trends. In calm markets the excess 7-day return by quintile of the scaled weekly rise is −0.7 %, −0.1 %, −0.6 %, +0.9 % and +4.4 % (top t 3.03). In agitated markets it is −2.8 % to −2.0 % (top t −1.11). Three caveats apply: agitation here is a 60-day rank of the 30-day swing, not the profile's 1-year rank; the t is not day-clustered; and in-profile day-clustering cut a comparable t from 2.72 to 1.97.
findings.F4: In a falling, agitated market, the next day's excess return falls steadily as the day's scaled move rises: by quintile of the 1-day move it is +1.2 %, +1.3 %, −1.1 %, −1.4 % and −1.4 % (day-clustered t 1.49, 1.80, −1.26, −2.34, −2.03). After the largest rises, the excess return over the next 3 days is −3.6 % (t −1.74). The choppy agitated cell shows the same next-day giveback after the largest rises (−1.4 %, t −2.29), while rising agitated does not (+0.6 %, t 0.96).
findings.F5: Over all coins, after the weakest fifth of scaled 1-day moves, the next day's excess return is +0.76 % (t 5.25, 1653 cases). This is the rebound after a fall the portfolio already holds many times (12 falling agitated long strategies), so it is not a discovery.
findings.F6: Weekday next-day excess returns, Wednesday −0.44 % (t −2.60) and Friday +0.37 % (t 2.85), do not stand out among the 7 days and the many angles looked at. The late-week gain is already held (045-01).

ideas.idea: In a calm market, the larger a coin's rise over the past 7 days against its usual daily swing over the past 30 days, the larger its further rise over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader can use a quiet coin's unusually large weekly rise as a reason to stay long for the following week, whatever the coin's 60-day trend.
ideas.name: calm market weekly rise continues

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, the larger a coin's rise on a day against its usual daily swing over the past 30 days, the more it falls back over the next 1 to 3 days.
ideas.consequence: A trader can sell or short a sharp up day in a falling, swinging coin, expecting the bounce to be given back within days.
ideas.name: falling agitated rally fades
